name: Broccoli White Bean Soup
ingredients: 300 g broccoli, cut into small florets
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the broccoli, beans and stock. Simmer for 10 minutes until the broccoli is tender but still bright green.
Stir in lemon juice and nutritional yeast if using; season with salt and pepper.
note: A creamy soup with no cream: the beans do the thickening and add fibre and protein.
